entries.description: The HTTP contract of PII Guard, an open-source OpenAI-compatible privacy gateway: it detects personal data in text and images, replaces it with reversible placeholders before a request reaches the model, and restores the original values in the answer.
representativeQueries: Mask personal data before sending prompts to an LLM
Restore placeholders in model responses back to original values
Set each entity type to mask, keep or block

entries.description: Plain-text overview of PII Guard for language models: capabilities, public pages, docs, API endpoints, the privacy boundary and benchmarks.
representativeQueries: How does PII Guard mask and restore personal data in AI agent traffic?
Which API endpoints and entity policies does PII Guard support?
Where are PII Guard's benchmark results and self-hosting docs?
